title: Backfill the missing v0.6.0 GitHub Release from CHANGELOG.md without moving releases/latest (OPAG-646)
description: Found while doing LCLI-623 (2026-09-27) and approved by opum-agent under OPAG-646: v0.6.0 has a git tag (tag object 800873f7 -> commit e3d75867, the fresh-history root) and an npm publish (@opum-ai/lore@0.6.0, 2026-09-09T19:26:14Z) but had no GitHub Release. Same pattern as LCLI-623. Out of scope by opum-agent's ruling: v0.1.0..v0.5.0 are on npm but have no git tag at all; minting tags for them is a separate decision, not a backfill.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release exists for the existing tag v0.6.0, titled Lore CLI 0.6.0, whose body is the ## [0.6.0] section of CHANGELOG.md verbatim; the tag is not moved or recreated
releases/latest is still v0.11.0 after the release is created, read back by API
The release URL and the read-backs are recorded on this task

implementationNotes: Done 2026-09-27: gh release create v0.6.0 --verify-tag --title 'Lore CLI 0.6.0' --notes-file <awk-extracted ## [0.6.0] section, 38 lines> --latest=false. URL https://github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli/releases/tag/v0.6.0. Read-backs by API right after: releases/tags/v0.6.0 name 'Lore CLI 0.6.0' draft=false prerelease=false; body equals the CHANGELOG section modulo leading/trailing blank lines (cmp); releases/latest = v0.11.0; ls-remote v0.6.0 still tag 800873f7 -> commit e3d75867 (unmoved); gh release list now returns 10 releases for the 10 tags on origin.
finalSummary: Backfilled the missing v0.6.0 GitHub Release (OPAG-646, approved by opum-agent after LCLI-623 found it): 'Lore CLI 0.6.0' on the existing tag with the CHANGELOG ## [0.6.0] section as body, non-draft, non-prerelease, --latest=false. Verified by API: release shape, body vs CHANGELOG, releases/latest still v0.11.0, tag unmoved, 10 releases for 10 tags. https://github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli/releases/tag/v0.6.0. v0.1.0..v0.5.0 have no tags and are out of scope by ruling.
